History:
Angers is a genetically engineered human, that was modified and turned into a cyborg, based on UFS data of Saya Neo.
Her creator was Kiryu Mikoto and she was used in missions against both Demon and Taimanin. She grew up surrounded only by adults in the UFS who would only send her into battle, which led her to become very cold and indifferent. Her experiences eventually led her to suppress her own emotions and made her shy.
